auths.description:
If set, then this {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth} represents a combination of multiple auths.
NOTE: if specified, then the auths referenced will be used - other fields in this instance will
be ignored.

As an analogy, if a specific auth is a "key", then this enables the ability to
specify "keychains" based on existing "keys".
See {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client#router} for an example for where the
"keychain" concept may be used.

title:
Base interface for types that represent auth configurations for LLM Services.
Since there can be multiple auths set up for a single LLM Service provider, this
type is {@link Named}.
In addition, multiple individual auths can be aggregated into a single one, for
convenient reference, by creating a new auth with {@link #auths} field populated.
The default auth instance shall be named "default", so in order to configure
a default instance, be sure to create a configuration with that name.

See {@link GenaiCore.Llm.AzureOpenAi.Auth}, as an example of a type implementing this interface.
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Auth
